issue.title: Stale symvision --epic-symbol whitelist entries for closed bead sase-js fail just lint
issue.description: Justfile's _lint-symvision recipe (around lines 306-310) still passes 5 --epic-symbol "sase-js(...)" exemptions (ArtifactRefKindAlias, CanonicalArtifactRef, canonical_artifact_ref_kind, artifact_ref_expansion_validate, ArtifactRefUseRecord) for epic bead sase-js, which is now closed. This makes 'just lint'/'just check' fail deterministically at the symvision stage with 'bead sase-js is closed. Remove this stale --epic-symbol entry and clean up the symbol.' for all 5 entries. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to in-progress work via 'git stash; just _lint-symvision; git stash pop' on clean master (d4c4efda5). Fix: remove the 5 stale --epic-symbol "sase-js(...)" lines from Justfile and, per sase/memory/symvision.md, either mark the underlying symbols appropriately (e.g. rename private, add other suppression) or confirm they are now legitimately used so no epic exemption is needed at all.

evidence.note: Proposed by sase-k0.2 and independently reproduced during sase-k0 landing on 2026-08-12 at HEAD 95a9b4575 after just install: just symvision fails on the five stale sase-js --epic-symbol entries still present at Justfile:306-310. Exact duplicate; no new task created.

Independently reproduced at HEAD 95a9b4575 while implementing sase/repos/plans/202608/stitch_create_exclude.md: 'git stash; just check-full; git stash pop' on clean master hits the same 5 stale sase-js --epic-symbol entries at the symvision lint stage. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to that change; proceeded by running the remaining check-full gates individually, skipping only _lint-symvision.

payload.entry: Verified during sase-k0.4.2 landing: the five stale sase-js --epic-symbol entries in Justfile's _lint-symvision recipe were already removed by commit c30bcb012c50f36b9e6b240d146fffa2cf3d8a8c ('chore(symvision): retire epic-js whitelist, delete or wire up its five symbols'), which also disposed of the underlying symbols (deleted ArtifactRefKindAlias/canonical_artifact_ref_kind as dead code; added explicit type annotations to make CanonicalArtifactRef/ArtifactRefUseRecord call sites visible to symvision; wired artifact_ref_expansion_validate into _STITCH_EXPANSION_FORMAT/_PATCH_EXPANSION_FORMAT validation). Confirmed clean via grep -n sase-js Justfile (no matches) and just symvision (All public/private classes/functions are used properly!). No further code cleanup required.

Duplicate of the fix landed in commit c30bcb012 (retire epic-js Justfile whitelist); just symvision verified passing with zero sase-js references remaining. Closing as done so the duplicate does not remain actionable, per epic sase-k0's landing plan (sase-k0.2's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP).
